sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:135

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:135:1
items.html: A tower flying in the air, which is the discernment of the Lamed itself; now, it is suspended and held in the first phase, called air: For the Mem of Tzelem, which is AVI, is the very essence of the light, and the Lamed, which is YESHSUT, is only the discernment of garments for the TNHY of AVI, as above; and this is what he says, that the Lamed is suspended and held in the first phase, called air, and therefore it is called a tower flying in the air. For a tower means the light of Gadlut and the illumination of Hochma, and nevertheless it is suspended and drawn from the light of Hassadim of AVI. Understand this. And see the Zohar, Yitro, page 91a.
